scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I am a messenger from the Royal court, sent to find a reliable adventurer. This is all about the very important issues of our nation.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我是來自王宮的信使，奉命尋找一位可靠的冒險者。
此事關乎我國極其重要的議題。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
It might have brought national disorder, but people are all wary about the rebirth of the devil. We are in the perfect times to process this issue without making any additional fuss.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
雖然這可能引發國家動盪，但人們對惡魔的復活都心存警惕。
現在是處理此事的最佳時機，可以避免引起額外的騷亂。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Oh, I don't want you to panic too much... Hmm... what I want to say is, Tristan the third, the ruler of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[信使]
哦，我不想讓你太驚慌... 嗯... 我想說的是，盧恩·米德加茲的統治者，特里斯坦三世...

scripts.text: Passed away?
scripts.translation: 去世了？

scripts.text: Came for a celebration again?
scripts.translation: 又來慶祝了？

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
You already know about that...
Then, I don't need to give
you any further explanation.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
你竟然已經知道了...
那麼，我就不必再做進一步的解釋了。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
The King's position cannot
be empty for too long.
Now, the debate over selecting our next King is actively in progress. Please give us a hand with this, for the tomorrow of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
王位不能長期空缺。
目前，關於下一任國王的選拔辯論正在進行中。
請為我們出一份力，為了盧恩·米德加茲的明天。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
...

[Messenger]
What are you thinking?
Do you really think a celebration is momentous for a nation right now?
scripts.translation:
[信使]
你在想什麼？
你真的認為在國家當前局勢下，慶祝是一件大事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Yeah...
It's quite natural for you to expect nothing. I still don't know how to express this to you. Don't be too perplexed.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
是啊...
你一無所知也很正常。我還不知道該怎麼跟你說才好。別太困惑。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Tristan the 3rd, the ruler of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[信使]
盧恩·米德加茲的統治者，特里斯坦三世...

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
...
has passed away.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
...
已經去世了。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
To prevent the people's disorder, it won't yet be announced. The Court is focused on selecting the next king right now. They are very busy considering it.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
為了防止民眾動盪，此事尚未公佈。宮廷正專注於選拔下一任國王。他們正忙於考慮此事。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
You can learn more details in court. My mission is only to deliver this message to a reliable and brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
你可以在宮廷瞭解更多詳情。我的任務只是將這條訊息傳達給一位可靠且勇敢的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Please...Please...
Lend a hand for the future
of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
請...請...
為了盧恩·米德加茲王國的未來，伸出援手。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
It might have brought national disorder, but people are all wary about the rebirth of the devil. We are in the perfect times to process this issue without making any additional fuss.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
雖然這可能引發國家動盪，但人們對惡魔的復活都心存警惕。
現在是處理此事的最佳時機，可以避免引起額外的騷亂。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
The King hasn't appeared
in public for some time.
Many are curious about the situation.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
國王已經有一段時間沒有公開露面了。
許多人都對情況感到好奇。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I hate my duty to deliver
this sorrowful reality to others.
I think you already have a clue from my words...
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我討厭我的職責，將這一悲傷的現實傳達給他人。
我想從我的話中，你已經有所察覺了...

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
King Tristan...
scripts.translation:
[信使]
特里斯坦國王...

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
King Tristan...
...passed away...
...after a long time of suffering acutely from illness.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
特里斯坦國王...
...去世了...
...在長期遭受重病折磨之後。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
The Royal Court is now in the process of selecting the next king. My mission is to find a devoted adventurer and send them to court.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
王宮目前正在選拔下一任國王。我的任務是尋找一位忠誠的冒險者，並送他們前往宮廷。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
They will let you know what
you have to do in court.
I hope you will help bring
peace to Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
他們會告訴你需要在宮廷做什麼。
希望你能幫助盧恩·米德加茲恢復和平。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I am a messenger of Rune-Midgarts.
Is there something special
in this country?
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我是盧恩·米德加茲的信使。
這個國家有什麼特別的事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
Haven't you seen something mysterious? Or heard some gossip?
scripts.translation:
[信使]
你沒看到什麼神秘的事情嗎？或者聽到什麼傳聞？

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I want you to go to the Prontera Royal Court to help in the next King's selection.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我要你去普隆德拉王宮，協助下一任國王的選拔。

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I will stay here to find other adventurers. May your heart bring great glory to Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我會留在這裡尋找其他冒險者。願你的心靈為盧恩·米德加茲帶來榮耀！

scripts.text:
[Messenger]
I am on a mission now. I think you may be looking for a different location. Ask others.
scripts.translation:
[信使]
我現在正在執行任務。我想你可能在找別的地方。問問其他人吧。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Judge!
How goes it? I don't think it is easy to meet seven candidates and appraise them.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
評估員！
進展如何？我覺得會見並評估七位候選人並不容易。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ha. Are you done?
You are a fast worker, getting the job done!
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
哈。結束了嗎？
你工作真快，效率很高！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Let me have the scoop on the candidates~
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
讓我聽聽關於候選人的訊息~

scripts.text:
-I talked about my impression
of the candidates for prince,
to the Inspector, right away.
I'm sure, I only give clear
and concise facts to him.-
scripts.translation:
-我立刻向檢查員講述了我對王子候選人的印象。
我相信，我只向他提供了清晰且簡潔的事實。-

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Hmm... is that so? What you've said has helped me a lot. Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
嗯...是嗎？你說的話對我幫助很大。謝謝你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
By the way, I happened
to hear a rumor about
Prince Eigen Ahrum of the Walter family. Could you appraise all the candidates, one more time? I need this done urgently.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
順便說一下，我偶然聽到了關於沃爾特家族的艾根·阿魯姆王子的傳聞。你能再評估一次所有候選人嗎？我需要儘快完成這件事。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Now the whole picture may change... Others must probably be the same. But I worry about Eigen Ahrum because I can't neglect any rumors about any candidate.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
現在整體情況可能會改變...其他人可能也是如此。但我擔心艾根·阿魯姆，因為我不能忽視任何關於任何候選人的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Okay, so... please go in there one more time.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
好的，那麼...請再進去一次。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What's wrong with you?
This is not an open area!
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你怎麼了？
這裡不是公開區域！

scripts.text: Alright, Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的，好的

scripts.text: The Messenger directed me here.
scripts.translation: 信使指引我來的

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
If you know it, why are you here? Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
如果你知道的話，為什麼還在這裡？快離開這裡！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I don't think
that he is an experienced appraiser...
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
我覺得他不是一個有經驗的評估員...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
......

[Inspector]
The Messenger checked only for your physical aptitude, and simply sent a warrior to Court. That's what his duty is all about.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
信使只檢查了你的身體條件，就把戰士送到了宮廷。這就是他的職責所在。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Checking your qualification is a matter that concerns me.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
審查你的資格是我的職責。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You are an experienced traveler. You have enough strength, but... The Court doesn't choose a person based only on his or her great strength and battle experience.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你是一位經驗豐富的旅行者。你擁有足夠的力量，但是...宮廷選拔人才，不僅僅看力量和戰鬥經驗。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
To check someone's quality
you have to have enough
personality about you.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
要考察別人的素質，你自己必須具備足夠的品格。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
In that sense, I want to do a simple experiment.
Let's test you.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
從這個意義上說，我想做一個簡單的實驗。
讓我們來測試一下你。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
This won't be complicated. You are just needed to give a quick answer, frankly please, after each given situation.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
這不會很複雜。你只需要在每種情況下，快速、坦率地給出回答。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
kay, let's start. Get ready. Listen carefully and answer.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
好，我們開始。做好準備。仔細聽題並回答。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What do you think is the
most important thing to consider
as a leader of a hunt party?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你認為作為狩獵隊伍的首領，最重要的考量是什麼？

scripts.text: Strength and characteristics of the monster.
scripts.translation: 魔物的力量和特性

scripts.text: Efficiency of the hunt.
scripts.translation: 狩獵的效率

scripts.text: What we can get from the hunt.
scripts.translation: 狩獵能獲得的收益

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What if we lose a party member
during battle?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
如果在戰鬥中失去了隊伍成員怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Keep fighting until we can do it.
scripts.translation: 堅持戰鬥直到成功

scripts.text: Find a new place and try differently.
scripts.translation: 換個地方，嘗試不同的策略

scripts.text: Stop hunting and replenish.
scripts.translation: 停止狩獵，進行補給

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What you get as a result of the hunt...
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
狩獵結束後獲得的戰利品...

scripts.text: Share it as agreed prior.
scripts.translation: 按事先約定分配

scripts.text: I don't want to care for sharing.
scripts.translation: 我不在乎怎麼分配

scripts.text: Give it to the member that needs it.
scripts.translation: 分給需要的成員

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What type of job class member
has to be cured while the enemy still lives?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
哪種職業的成員必須在敵人存活時進行治療？

scripts.text: Priest, healer class.
scripts.translation: 牧師，治療職業

scripts.text: Hunter, damage dealer.
scripts.translation: 獵人，輸出職業

scripts.text: Lord Knight, tanker.
scripts.translation: 騎士領主，坦克職業

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Whom do you want to befriend the most?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你最想和誰成為朋友？

scripts.text: A strong person.
scripts.translation: 強大的人

scripts.text: An experienced person.
scripts.translation: 經驗豐富的人

scripts.text: A kind person.
scripts.translation: 善良的人

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What was your ability that helped
you the most during your training?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
在訓練中，哪項能力對你幫助最大？

scripts.text: Relationships with people.
scripts.translation: 人際關係

scripts.text: Plenty of information gathering.
scripts.translation: 廣泛的資訊收集

scripts.text: Discernment and driving force.
scripts.translation: 判斷力與執行力

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
How do you give encouragement to others, usually?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你通常如何鼓勵他人？

scripts.text: Refer to a past failure.
scripts.translation: 提及過去的失敗

scripts.text: Hesitating is the worst thing.
scripts.translation: 猶豫是最糟糕的

scripts.text: You are not alone.
scripts.translation: 你不是一個人

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What is an ultimate virtue
in your life?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你人生中的終極美德是什麼？

scripts.text: Growth of oneself.
scripts.translation: 自我成長

scripts.text: World peace.
scripts.translation: 世界和平

scripts.text: The pursuit of truth.
scripts.translation: 追求真理

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What would you want to keep
the most if you were on a 
deserted island?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
如果你被困在荒島上，你最想保留什麼？

scripts.text: Map
scripts.translation: 地圖

scripts.text: Flint
scripts.translation: 燧石

scripts.text: Weapon
scripts.translation: 武器

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What type of story do you like the most?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你最喜歡哪種型別的故事？

scripts.text: Love story.
scripts.translation: 愛情故事

scripts.text: Heroic epic.
scripts.translation: 英雄史詩

scripts.text: Religious tale.
scripts.translation: 宗教傳說

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You've come to engage the
new monster in a new area.
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你來到了新區域，準備挑戰新的魔物。
你會怎麼做？

scripts.text: Attack first.
scripts.translation: 先發制人

scripts.text: Observe from a distance.
scripts.translation: 遠距離觀察

scripts.text: Flee away.
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What has to be done first when
ruling the Rune-Midgarts kingdom?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
統治盧恩·米德加茲王國時，首先要做什麼？

scripts.text: Dominate countries by reinforcing militia.
scripts.translation: 加強軍備，征服各國

scripts.text: Advancement of economy and technology.
scripts.translation: 發展經濟與科技

scripts.text: Keep public security firm.
scripts.translation: 維護社會治安

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Your humanity test is done.
You have been living...
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你的人性測試結束了。
你一直過著...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong conviction,
and reasonable judgement,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
信念堅定、判斷合理的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong bravery,
but also you've had a
temperate life.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
勇敢無畏，卻又懂得節制的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with a decisive mind.
You could overcome hardships with it.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
果斷決絕的生活。
憑藉它，你能夠克服苦難。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with firmness,
and reasonable judgement,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
意志堅定、判斷合理的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with reasonable judgement
and a harmonic sensibility,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
理性判斷與和諧感性兼具的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with a calm and prudent decision.
I think you could also have had many good experiences.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
冷靜而審慎的生活。
我想，你也一定有過許多美好的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong bravery,
but also you've had a
temperate life.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
勇敢無畏，卻又懂得節制的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with reasonable judgement
and peaceful sensibility,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
理性判斷與寧靜感性兼具的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
...Erm, actually...
You didn't distort to either way...
and stability and harmony were
an important virtue in your life.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
...嗯，其實...
你並沒有偏向任何一方...
穩定與和諧是你生活中重要的美德。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I think you are
qualified enough to evaluate others. I apologize for my rude behavior to you in the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
我認為你完全有資格去評價他人。
我為一開始對你的無禮行為表示歉意。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
So, I ask you to do us a favor. You have become a regular adventurer appraiser.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
所以，我請你幫我們一個忙。
你已成為一名正式的冒險者評估員。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ah, you've spent a long time with me. You must be very tired. Before starting work, if you need some preparation, take off now and come back to me later. I will be waiting here for you.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
啊，你和我在一起已經很久了。
你一定很累了。
在開始工作之前，如果需要做準備，現在可以先離開，稍後再回來找我。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I don't think you are
an experienced adventurer...
And this is an important issue for the nation. I can't give this job to anyone like you.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
我覺得你並不像是一位經驗豐富的冒險者...
而且這對國家來說是一件大事。
我不能把這個任務交給像你這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
But, if you prove yourself a strong adventurer, then I will let you pass the first qualification test.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
但是，如果你能證明自己是一名強大的冒險者，那麼我會讓你通過第一道資格測試。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Have you heard of Glastheim? In that area, there are monsters named Knights of Abyss.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你聽說過葛拉斯特海姆嗎？
在那個地區，有一種名為深淵騎士的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
After beating the knights of abyss
bring 2 ^ff0000Reins^000000.
If you can do this mission,
I will respect your strength.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
擊敗深淵騎士後，帶回2個^ff0000韁繩^000000。
如果你能完成這個任務，我會尊重你的實力。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Let's continue our talk
after getting the 2 Reins.
Ciao...
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
拿到2個韁繩後，我們再繼續談話。
再見...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ahh, you came to meet me before huh? I guess you've already been to Glastheim.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
啊，你之前就來找我了？
看來你已經去過葛拉斯特海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Do you have the 2 reins I mentioned?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你有我提到的那2個韁繩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ooh!
Frankly, I didn't expect you to bring them. You are great.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
哦！
說實話，我沒想到你能把它們帶回來。
你很棒。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Alright, good. You proved your strength for yourself. Now you passed one exam. All but one.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
很好。你證明了自己的實力。
現在你通過了一項考試。
只剩最後一項了。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
The judge to appraise princes should build up his character too. Strength cannot cover everything. Personality should come along with it
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
評估王子的評判者也應該具備高尚的品格。
實力不能涵蓋一切，性格也必須與之相符。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
In a sense, the next examination is to test your character. It is just a series of simple questions, but relax first, and be prepared mentally... then come and talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
從某種意義上說，下一項考試是測試你的品格。
這只是一系列簡單的問題，但請先放鬆一下，做好心理準備...
然後再來找我談話。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You've never even taken such a dangerous mission before! How dare you think you could come to this place? I don't think you can take the job of evaluating princes.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你甚至從未執行過如此危險的任務！
你怎麼敢想你能來這個地方？
我認為你不能勝任評估王子的職位。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Now, you can come back later.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
現在，你可以稍後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Now are you ready?
This test is not that hard though...
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你準備好了嗎？
雖然這項測試不算太難...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
This is done to know your attitude and behavior in certain situations. Listen carefully to my questions, and answer frankly in regards to the episodes of your trip.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
這是為了瞭解你在特定情況下的態度和行為。
請仔細聽我的問題，並如實回答關於你旅途經歷的問題。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Now, let me begin.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
那麼，我們開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What do you think is the
most important thing to consider
as a leader of a hunt party?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你認為作為狩獵隊伍的首領，最重要的考量是什麼？

scripts.text: Strength and characteristics of the monster.
scripts.translation: 魔物的力量和特性

scripts.text: Efficiency of the hunt.
scripts.translation: 狩獵的效率

scripts.text: What we can get from the hunt.
scripts.translation: 狩獵能獲得的收益

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What if we lose a party member
during battle?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
如果在戰鬥中失去了隊伍成員怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Keep fighting until we can do it.
scripts.translation: 堅持戰鬥直到成功

scripts.text: Find a new place and try differently.
scripts.translation: 換個地方，嘗試不同的策略

scripts.text: Stop hunting and replenish.
scripts.translation: 停止狩獵，進行補給

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What you get as a result of the hunt...
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
狩獵結束後獲得的戰利品...

scripts.text: Share it as agreed prior.
scripts.translation: 按事先約定分配

scripts.text: I don't want to care for sharing.
scripts.translation: 我不在乎怎麼分配

scripts.text: Give it to the member that needs it.
scripts.translation: 分給需要的成員

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What type of job class member
has to be cured while the enemy still lives?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
哪種職業的成員必須在敵人存活時進行治療？

scripts.text: Priest, healer class.
scripts.translation: 牧師，治療職業

scripts.text: Hunter, damage dealer.
scripts.translation: 獵人，輸出職業

scripts.text: Lord Knight, tanker.
scripts.translation: 騎士領主，坦克職業

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Whom do you want to befriend the most?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你最想和誰成為朋友？

scripts.text: A strong person.
scripts.translation: 強大的人

scripts.text: An experienced person.
scripts.translation: 經驗豐富的人

scripts.text: A kind person.
scripts.translation: 善良的人

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What was your ability that helped
you the most during your training?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
在訓練中，哪項能力對你幫助最大？

scripts.text: Relationships with people.
scripts.translation: 人際關係

scripts.text: Plenty of information gathering.
scripts.translation: 廣泛的資訊收集

scripts.text: Discernment and driving force.
scripts.translation: 判斷力與執行力

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
How do you give encouragement to others, usually?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你通常如何鼓勵他人？

scripts.text: Refer to a past failure.
scripts.translation: 提及過去的失敗

scripts.text: Hesitating is the worst thing.
scripts.translation: 猶豫是最糟糕的

scripts.text: You are not alone.
scripts.translation: 你不是一個人

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What is an ultimate virtue
in your life?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你人生中的終極美德是什麼？

scripts.text: Growth of oneself.
scripts.translation: 自我成長

scripts.text: World peace.
scripts.translation: 世界和平

scripts.text: The pursuit of truth.
scripts.translation: 追求真理

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What would you want to keep
the most if you were on a 
deserted island?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
如果你被困在荒島上，你最想保留什麼？

scripts.text: Map
scripts.translation: 地圖

scripts.text: Flint
scripts.translation: 燧石

scripts.text: Weapon
scripts.translation: 武器

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What type of story do you like the most?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你最喜歡哪種型別的故事？

scripts.text: Love story.
scripts.translation: 愛情故事

scripts.text: Heroic epic.
scripts.translation: 英雄史詩

scripts.text: Religious tale.
scripts.translation: 宗教傳說

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You've come to engage the
new monster in a new area.
What do you do?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你來到了新區域，準備挑戰新的魔物。
你會怎麼做？

scripts.text: Attack first.
scripts.translation: 先發制人

scripts.text: Observe from a distance.
scripts.translation: 遠距離觀察

scripts.text: Flee away.
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What has to be done first when
ruling the Rune-Midgarts kingdom?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
統治盧恩·米德加茲王國時，首先要做什麼？

scripts.text: Dominate countries by reinforcing militia.
scripts.translation: 加強軍備，征服各國

scripts.text: Advancement of economy and technology.
scripts.translation: 發展經濟與科技

scripts.text: Keep public security firm.
scripts.translation: 維護社會治安

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Your humanity test is done.
You have been living...
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你的人性測試結束了。
你一直過著...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong conviction,
and reasonable judgement,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
信念堅定、判斷合理的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong bravery,
but also you've had a
temperate life.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
勇敢無畏，卻又懂得節制的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with a decisive mind.
You could overcome hardships with it.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
果斷決絕的生活。
憑藉它，你能夠克服苦難。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with firmness,
and reasonable judgement,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
意志堅定、判斷合理的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with reasonable judgement
and a harmonic sensibility,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
理性判斷與和諧感性兼具的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with a calm and prudent decision.
I think you could also have had many good experiences.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
冷靜而審慎的生活。
我想，你也一定有過許多美好的經歷。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with strong bravery,
but also you've had a
temperate life.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
勇敢無畏，卻又懂得節制的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
with reasonable judgement
and peaceful sensibility,
so far.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
理性判斷與寧靜感性兼具的生活。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
...Erm, actually...
You didn't distort to either way...
and stability and harmony were
an important virtue in your life.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
...嗯，其實...
你並沒有偏向任何一方...
穩定與和諧是你生活中重要的美德。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I think you are
qualified enough to evaluate others. I apologize for my rude behavior to you in the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
我認為你完全有資格去評價他人。
我為一開始對你的無禮行為表示歉意。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
So, I ask you to do us a favor. You have become a regular adventurer appraiser.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
所以，我請你幫我們一個忙。
你已成為一名正式的冒險者評估員。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Ah, you've spent a long time with me. You must be very tired. Before starting work, if you need some preparation, take off now and come back to me later. I will be waiting here for you.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
啊，你和我在一起已經很久了。
你一定很累了。
在開始工作之前，如果需要做準備，現在可以先離開，稍後再回來找我。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Welcome...
I will give you some
instructions on what to do,
and what one has to be careful with, when dealing with princes. Pay attention to me.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
歡迎...
我將向你說明在與王子打交道時該做什麼，以及需要注意什麼。
請仔細聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I will answer your questions first.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
我先回答你的問題。

scripts.text: What should I do, exactly?
scripts.translation: 我具體該做什麼？

scripts.text: The King died because of his illness?
scripts.translation: 國王是因為生病去世的嗎？

scripts.text: Is my mission confidential??
scripts.translation: 我的任務是保密的嗎？

scripts.text: I have no more questions.
scripts.translation: 我沒有其他問題了

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
We have seven candidates from seven families. One per each family. The candidates are all in the same place, where I will introduce them to you.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
我們有來自七個家族的七名候選人。
每個家族各出一人。
候選人都在同一個地方，我會在那裡向你介紹他們。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You have to meet the candidates one by one, and ask some questions about their quality; or observe their actions, then come back to me and explain all that you observed in detail.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你需要逐一會見候選人，詢問關於他們品質的問題；或者觀察他們的行為，然後回來向我詳細彙報你觀察到的一切。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
The original rule is that the quality of princes has to be appraised by royal families for a long time, and one has to be elected by internal ordinance.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
原本的規則是，王子的品質必須由王室家族經過長時間的評估，並通過內部法令進行選舉。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Because of the resurrection of the devil Satan Morocc, people are too uneasy to follow regular announcements, and the atmosphere of the kingdom is not stable.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
由於魔王夢羅克的復活，人們過於不安，無法遵循常規的公告，王國的局勢也不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Each kingdom is busy preventing the interference of Satan Morocc too.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
各個王國都忙於防範魔王夢羅克的干涉。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
So this time, the Court decided to change its ways, giving the opportunity to appraise the candidates to famous and devoted adventurers like yourself. That's why you are here.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
因此，這次宮廷決定改變方式，將評估候選人的機會交給像你這樣著名且忠誠的冒險者。
這就是你在這裡的原因。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
How absurd that you ask that!! I already told you clearly that King Tristan died of illness, didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你怎麼會問這種荒謬的問題！！
我已經明確告訴過你，國王特里斯坦是因病去世的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Don't you have anything else to be curious about?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你難道沒有其他好奇的事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Sure...
It's natural to announce the death of the King. But the atmosphere of the nation is not ripe for it. This is our only alternative for now.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
當然...
宣佈國王的死訊是自然的。
但國家的氛圍尚未成熟到可以接受這一點。
這是我們目前唯一的替代方案。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Princes cannot go outside on their own will. People cannot go to the place where the princes are.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
王子不能擅自外出。
人們也不能去王子所在的地方。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
I think this is enough
instruction for this.
Now I will let you know
where you can meet the princes.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
我想這些說明已經足夠了。
現在我將告訴你在哪裡可以會見王子。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
When you get to the medic officer's room, a soldier will be standing on a strange spot. You can find that there isn't a door there.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
當你到達醫務兵的房間時，會有一名士兵站在一個奇怪的位置。你會發現那裡並沒有門。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Behind the soldier, you can find a secret door. If you talk to the soldier, the soldier will allow you to get in.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
在士兵身後，你可以找到一扇暗門。如果你和士兵交談，他會允許你進入。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
As I have expressed, this is a very important issue for the Rune-Midgarts kingdom. Although I've stressed this point repeateadly, I cannot stress it enough.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
正如我所強調的，這對盧恩·米德加茲王國來說是一件非常重要的事情。雖然我反覆強調過這一點，但我還是覺得強調得不夠。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Please behave accordingly.
Thanks for your effort.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
請照此行事。
感謝你的努力。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You got instructions as to what you should do, didn't you? This issue is not that worthless that you can take it with ease! Pay attention to this!
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你已經收到了關於該做什麼的指示，對吧？這件事並不像你想像的那麼微不足道，不能掉以輕心！請認真對待！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
If you are not motivated to do it, I will find another adventurer. You can go back to your business, if you want to.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
如果你沒有動力去做這件事，我會另找一位冒險者。如果你願意的話，可以回去做你的事了。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
How is it going?
Grading someone is not a piece of cake. It's real hard work indeed. You do the hard work for our country.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
進展如何？
評估某人並不是一件輕鬆的事。這確實是辛苦的工作。你為我們的國家付出了艱辛的努力。

scripts.text: -I tell him about the Ahrum and Ernst accident.-
scripts.translation: -我告訴他關於阿魯姆和恩斯特事故的事。-

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
What!? I can't believe it!
Wha-, that's so...
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
什麼！？我簡直不敢相信！
什...這太...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
By Ernst's hand...?
Yes...?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
是恩斯特乾的...？
是的...？

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
You've fulfilled the job as
adventurer appraiser fully.
I really appreciate your assistance thus far. Due to your help, the future of the kingdom is indebted to you.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你完全履行了冒險者評估員的職責。
我非常感激你迄今為止的幫助。多虧了你的協助，王國的未來才得以保全。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(He doesn't seem to be suprised too much.. Could there be a reason? Now I am suspicious...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他似乎並沒有太驚訝...難道有什麼原因嗎？我現在開始懷疑了...）

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Hey, the things you experienced here cannot be disclosed to others. You understand that this situation is fully confidential.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
嘿，你在這裡經歷的事情不能透露給其他人。你要明白，此事是絕對機密。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
So, keep up the good work.
For the Kingdom of Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
所以，繼續好好幹吧。
為了盧恩·米德加茲王國！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Then, let me hit the road..
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
那麼，我要出發了...

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
All for the glory
of Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
為了盧恩·米德加茲的榮耀！

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Hello, appraiser.
I hope you are able to finish your mission perfectly. Have you met with all the princes, like I told you to?
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你好，評估員。
我希望你能完美地完成你的任務。按照我告訴你的那樣，你見過所有的王子了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Very well.
I like hearing about the princes.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
很好。
我喜歡聽關於王子們的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Are you sure?
Please check on all the princes.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
你確定嗎？
請確認你已經見過所有的王子。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
Don't be coy. I'm sure you have done it already.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
別謙虛了。我相信你已經做過了。

scripts.text:
[Inspector]
My investigations on all the princes are done.
scripts.translation:
[檢查員]
我對所有王子的調查已經結束了。

scripts.text:
-Obssessed with making
lock and key.-
scripts.translation: -他似乎對製作鎖和鑰匙非常著迷。-

scripts.text:
[Erich]
...What bad luck I have!
But he insists me to be corrupted, knowing how it would be...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
...我的運氣真差！
但他堅持認為我已經被腐蝕了，儘管他知道那會是什麼樣子...

scripts.text:
[Erich]
These days, I have bad luck... Only harrassments happen to me...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
最近，我的運氣很差...只有麻煩事發生在我身上...

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Who are you?
I don't think you are eligible
to be entering this room?
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你是誰？
你應該沒有資格進入這個房間吧？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
I order you out of
my sight.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
我命令你從我的視線中消失。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Who are you?
Someone must have been instructed about the presence of the hidden entrance. Unless... Are you the adventurer appraiser?
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你是誰？
一定有人被指示過關於隱藏入口的存在。除非...你是冒險者評估員？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Are you?... Do me a favor then. I am a legitimate son from the Nerius family. My name is Erich. You can call me Prince Erich.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你是嗎？...那就幫我個忙。我是內裡烏斯家族的嫡子。我的名字是埃裡希。你可以叫我埃裡希王子。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
My full name is...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
我的全名是...

scripts.text:
[Erich]
That's enough.
You can ask information about me to my servant. I will take a rest.
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
夠了。
你可以向我的僕人詢問關於我的資訊。我要休息了。

scripts.text:
[Erich]
......My conscience!
It doesn't work well...
scripts.translation:
[埃裡希]
......我的良心！
它不太管用了...

scripts.text: -He seems to be so obssessed to care about anything else.-
scripts.translation: -他似乎太過沉迷，對其他任何事都漠不關心。-

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Ahh... mmm... I...
I... am so, sorry!
I... think I made a big mistake with the appraiser!
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
啊...嗯...我...
我...非常抱歉！
我...我想我在評估員的事情上犯了一個大錯誤！

scripts.text:
[Hans]
My prince didn't do anything wrong but, anyways, I apologize for anything to you!
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
我的王子並沒有做錯什麼，但無論如何，我向您道歉！

scripts.text:
Incessantly...-
-He has jitters whenever I react to him. His actions give me a feeling of pity.-
scripts.translation:
不停地...-
-每當我對他做出反應時，他都會緊張不安。他的行為讓我感到憐憫。-

scripts.text:
[Hans]
How are you doing, sir?
My name is Hans, servant of Prince Erich.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
您好，先生。
我叫漢斯，是埃裡希王子的僕人。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
我能為您做什麼？

scripts.text: Prince Erich told me to meet you.
scripts.translation: 埃裡希王子讓我來見你

scripts.text: Nothing much.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Did Prince Erich...?
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
是埃裡希王子...？

scripts.text: I want to listen to a story of him.
scripts.translation: 我想聽聽關於他的事

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Ahh, I see.
Frankly, Prince Erich is not interested in regime that much.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
啊，我明白了。
說實話，埃裡希王子對政治並不太感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
He writes in his journal daily. On his wedding day, he jotted down: 'Like, nothing special happened today'. He doesn't care about current events or human relationships.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
他每天都會寫日記。在他的婚禮那天，他寫道：“今天沒什麼特別的事發生”。他不在乎時事，也不在乎人際關係。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
What he likes is making locks.
He is eccentric, isn't he?
He is a kind of jester.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
他喜歡製作鎖。
他真古怪，不是嗎？
他就像個小丑。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
He doesn't like classy costumes either. He didn't even bring a dress suit here. And as soon as he got here, he was immersed in making a lock and key, like that.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
他也不喜歡華麗的服裝。他甚至沒帶禮服來這裡。而且他一到這兒，就沉浸在做鎖和鑰匙裡了，就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
I don't think I have the proper expression for you... I don't think I have something special to say about him to you. You can just appraise him as you see him...
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
我想我找不到合適的詞來形容他...我覺得沒有什麼特別的話要對您說。您可以按您看到的樣子去評價他...

scripts.text:
[Hans]
That's all I can say about this.
Huh...~
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
關於他，我只能說這麼多。
嗯...~

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Ah, Prince!
You can cut your finger!
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
啊，王子！
你會切到手指的！

scripts.text:
[Hans]
...Hmm he cannot even hear...
Oooooh...
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
...嗯，他連聽都聽不見...
噢噢噢...

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Did you meet the other princes?
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
你見過其他王子嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Although you may ask something, you will not hear anything special from him now.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
雖然你可以問點什麼，但現在你從他那裡聽不到什麼特別的話。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Hello?
Are you the new adventurer appraiser??
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
你好？
你是新的冒險者評估員嗎？？

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
...It is not beautiful.
It discomforts me...
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
...這並不美。
這讓我感到不適...

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
 feel very much displeased. Hey, what are you looking at? Get out!
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
我非常不高興。嘿，你在看什麼？滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
My beautiful body isn't in perfect condition right now. I don't want to show it to anyone today.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
我美麗的身體現在狀態不佳。我今天不想讓任何人看到。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
...What? What did you...
just say to me?... Huh?
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
...什麼？你剛才...
對我說了什麼？...嗯？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Huuuuuuu
The position is not suitable for you.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
呼————
這個位置不適合你。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Get away from me, as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
儘快離我遠點。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
La~ lalalala~ lalala~
Are you the person, supposed to look me over and appraise my quality?
scripts.translation:
[王子]
啦啦啦~ 啦啦啦啦~
你就是那個負責審視我、評估我品質的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
The daffodil you are gazing at is called Urugen. It bloomed at Wigner family.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你凝視的那朵水仙花名叫烏魯根。它是在維格納家族盛開的。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
I usually don't let anyone hear my beautiful voice, but this time, I will give a special service for you.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
我通常不讓人聽到我美妙的聲音，但這次，我要為你特別服務一次。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
listen...
Let me answer with my
unforgettable, clear and beautiful voice.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
聽好了...
讓我用那令人難忘、清澈而美麗的聲音來回答你。

scripts.text: I want to know your background.
scripts.translation: 我想了解你的身世

scripts.text: Let me know your view of the nation.
scripts.translation: 告訴我你對國家的看法

scripts.text: What are your hobbies or tastes?
scripts.translation: 你的愛好或品味是什麼？

scripts.text: Let me leave.
scripts.translation: 讓我離開

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
My dashing face from
childhood brought envy and jealousy from men, and endless proposals from women. I felt sick with it, so I came to be away from people.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
我英俊的面容從小就招致了男人的嫉妒，以及女人無盡的求婚。這讓我感到噁心，所以我選擇遠離人群。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
My beautiful person
shouldn't bear stuff like that sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
像我這樣美麗的人，有時不該承受這些。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
I became timid, gradually, in phases. I feel awe from men and women both, regardless of sexuality.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
我逐漸變得膽小起來。無論男女，人們都對我心懷敬畏，與性別無關。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
People should do what they are supposed to do. That's the source of drive for a nation. For me, my existence will be enough, for the nation.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
人們應該做他們該做的事。這是一個國家的動力源泉。對我來說，我的存在就足以支撐這個國家了。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
The presence of such a gorgeous king like me will be the light for people and the hope and reason for their lives.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
像我這樣華麗的國王的存在，將是人們的光，是他們生活的希望和理由。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
For sure, taking care of my body. Humans should pursue beauty. It's quite natural, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
當然，還有照顧我的身體。人類應該追求美。這不是很自然嗎？

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
In every case, there is an exception, like you in this court. Can you stand away from me a bit more? Because of your odor, I can hardly breathe.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
凡事皆有例外，比如你在這個宮廷裡。你能離我遠一點嗎？因為你的氣味，我幾乎無法呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Urugen]
Your spirit must be so strong. Looking over my beauty so long a time, you haven't lost your spirit yet.
scripts.translation:
[烏魯根]
你的精神一定很堅強。凝視我的美麗這麼久，你還沒有失去理智。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Such an idiot. I should have killed him earlier. Now I feel relieved.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
真是個白痴。我早該殺了他。現在我感到如釋重負。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Damn... Damn it!
Novice of Walter!!
How can I deal with this stress? Damn! Hell!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
該死...該死！
沃爾特家的毛頭小子！！
我該怎麼發洩這股火氣？該死！見鬼！

scripts.text:
-He is so blushed,
evidently shown on his face.-
scripts.translation: -他滿臉通紅，怒氣全寫在臉上。-

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
You are not supposed to be here!
Can't you keep away from me!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
你不該在這裡！
你能不能離我遠點！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Are you the new appraiser? I am fed up with the many visitors! Let's take up the main subject!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
你就是新來的評估員？我受夠了那些訪客！我們直接談正事吧！

scripts.text: -What subject should I start with?-
scripts.translation: -我該從哪個話題開始呢？-

scripts.text: Your background...
scripts.translation: 你的背景...

scripts.text: Your ambition...
scripts.translation: 你的抱負...

scripts.text: Your view of the nation...
scripts.translation: 你對國家的看法...

scripts.text: I want to meet others first.
scripts.translation: 我想先認識一下其他人

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I don't know how others react but, I feel very uptight with your question. I shouldn't, but, I don't have a different view!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我不知道別人怎麼想，但你的問題讓我非常緊張。我不該這樣，但我沒有其他看法！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
I am the prince; if you grumble, you become prince! I feel tiresome with this kind of questioning.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我才是王子；你要是不滿，你來當王子啊！這種問題讓我煩透了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
............
Yes, I understand. Go ahead...

[Helmut]
I am Helmut from Roewenburg.
What I like is smelling blood in the battlefield, and I enjoy festivals too.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我是來自羅文堡的赫爾穆特。
我喜歡在戰場上嗅到血腥味，也喜歡節日慶典。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
What I hate is sticking to formality, and talking much. As for ambition? What am I going to do when I become... king...?? I am asked this question many times.
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
我討厭拘泥於形式，也討厭喋喋不休。至於抱負？等我成為...國王...之後要做什麼？？這個問題我被問過很多次了。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
When I become king, I will reinforce our troops and conquer continent after unification of continent; I will eradicate all the monsters that are harmful to my people!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
等我成為國王，我會加強軍隊，在大陸統一後征服其他大陸；我將消滅所有危害我子民的魔物！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
~Kuffkuff~! I have a sore throat! It's been a while since I've used my throat. ~Kuffkuff~!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
~咳咳~！我喉嚨痛！好久沒這麼說話了。~咳咳~！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hey Calbern!
Bring beer! Beer!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
嘿，卡爾貝恩！
拿啤酒來！啤酒！

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Why are you still standing there? I have nothing else to say to you! Stand back!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
你還站在那兒幹什麼？我沒什麼好說的了！退後！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, Prince,
I will be back later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，王子，我稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Alright, up to you.
Hey! Hey Calbern!
Move your ass here with beer!
Do you want to be beaten down?
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
好吧，隨你。
嘿！嘿，卡爾貝恩！
帶著啤酒滾過來！
你想捱打嗎？

scripts.text:
[Calbern]
How are you doing, sir?
I am the servant of Prince Helmut...
Calbern.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
您好，大人。
我是赫爾穆特王子的僕人...
卡爾貝恩。

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
Hey Calbern!
Bring beer! Beer!
scripts.translation:
[赫爾穆特]
嘿，卡爾貝恩！
拿啤酒來！啤酒！

scripts.text:
[Calbern]
Oops, I am so sorry.
I got business...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾貝恩]
哎呀，非常抱歉。
我有事要忙...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Whatever the condition is, he is just a loser in the match of life.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
無論情況如何，他只是在人生的比賽中輸了而已。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
He gave up without any challenge. That's not what the man has to do. He is not as good as me. But okay. I am disappointed in him. Eigen Ahrum.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
他連挑戰都沒發起就放棄了。這不是一個男人該有的樣子。他不如我。不過好吧。我對他感到失望。艾根·阿魯姆。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Hi, how are you?
I don't think you deserve
to be here.
What about setting straight your genealogy first and then come?
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你好，最近怎麼樣？
我覺得你不配待在這裡。
先把你的家世理清了再來吧？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Come here.
You are the adventurer!
I love the challenge of hard trips too. Talkative old men and their adventures... You can't make me stop adventuring...
scripts.translation:
[王子]
過來。
你就是那個冒險者！
我也喜歡充滿挑戰的旅程。愛嘮叨的老頭和他的冒險故事... 你無法阻止我繼續冒險...

scripts.text:
[Prince]
My name is Poe.
I am the prince of the Richard family. Remember me, and be my supporter...
scripts.translation:
[王子]
我的名字是坡。
我是理查德家族的王子。記住我，併成為我的支持者...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Above all, I want to
test your ability as an adventurer. The ability test is not so serious. I just want to know how accurate your intuition is... That's all.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
首先，我想測試一下你作為冒險者的能力。能力測試並不嚴肅。我只是想知道你的直覺有多準確... 僅此而已。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
I don't want to talk with
a person of low intuition.
Let me explain briefly,
and test your own intuition.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我不想和直覺遲鈍的人交談。
讓我簡單解釋一下，然後測試一下你自己的直覺。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
My card has numbers from 1 to 13. You give me an answer about the card number I pick, whether it's a lesser or higher number.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我的牌上有1到13的數字。你告訴我我抽到的牌是比某個數大還是小。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Ah, of course, 7 is the middle number. 7 means no success or no failure. The goal of this game is to give the right answer 2 times in a row. Let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
啊，當然，7是中間數。7代表不輸也不贏。這個遊戲的目的是連續猜對2次。讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Yes, now choose one
from higher and lower.
Just one.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
是的，現在從“大”和“小”中選一個。
只選一個。

scripts.text: Higher
scripts.translation: 大

scripts.text: Lower
scripts.translation: 小

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Hmm... higher?...
I now pick a card!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
嗯... 大？...
我現在抽一張牌！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
It is...{0}!!

[Poe]
Whooah, you gave the right answer!
You won 2 times in a row right?...
scripts.translation:
[坡]
哇，你猜對了！
你連續猜對了2次？...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Whooah, you gave the right answer!
But you just gave the correct answer 1 time, as of yet.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
哇，你猜對了！
但到目前為止，你只猜對了1次。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
This game is a draw.
Do better next time.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
這局算平局。
下次加油。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Wrong...
Visit Hollgrehenn and ask him to refine your luck.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
錯了...
去找霍爾格雷恩，讓他幫你提升運氣。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Eh, lower?...
Look at my card!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
呃，小？...
看看我的牌！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
It is...{0}!!

[Poe]

You won 2 times in a row right?...
scripts.translation:

你連續猜對了2次？...

scripts.translation:

哇，你猜對了！
但到目前為止，你只猜對了1次。

scripts.text:

Do better next time.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
這局算平局。
下次加油。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Wrong...
Visit Hollgrehenn and ask him to refine your luck.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
錯了...
去找霍爾格雷恩，讓他幫你提升運氣。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Good, it's natural for me to disclose my words to such a high-intuitive person that likes pulling out all the cards.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
很好，向這樣直覺敏銳且喜歡把所有牌都翻出來的人透露我的想法是理所當然的。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
I could know about you with shown cards, very well, but let me share my hidden card this time! Ask me whatever you want to know.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
用明牌瞭解你，我已經很清楚了，但這次讓我亮出我的王牌吧！
你想問什麼都可以問我。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
So... What do you want to know?!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
那麼...你想問什麼？！

scripts.text: Your background story...
scripts.translation: 你的身世背景...

scripts.text: Your view of the nation...
scripts.translation: 你對國家的看法...

scripts.text: Hobbies and interests...
scripts.translation: 興趣愛好...

scripts.text: I will come by later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Poe]
My background...
Past stories.
I don't give it importance at all, so I can't remember it clearly...
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我的身世...
過去的經歷。
我完全不在意那些，所以記不太清了...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Can I just say I am a survivor from many matches and battles. That is quite fit for me. Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我只能說，我是許多場牌局和戰鬥中的倖存者。這很適合我。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
I've had to cope with many accidents and challenges... from which I have survived, and have been pursuing new things. Life means...
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我經歷過許多意外和挑戰...我都活了下來，並且一直在追求新事物。生命的意義就是...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Never let yourself down with given cards, and aim at deadly strokes!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
永遠不要對自己手中的牌失望，瞄準致命的打擊！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Hey it's cool, huh?
We have same tastes, haven't we?
scripts.translation:
[坡]
嘿，很酷吧？
我們的品味一樣，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Poe]
My opinion is a nation should provide the minimum guard for people, to guarantee respective freedom..
scripts.translation:
[坡]
我認為，國家應該為人們提供最低限度的保護，以保障各自的自由。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Men should challenge the stuff that they can be passionate about, so the free action of people should not be obstructed by their nation.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
人們應該去挑戰自己熱愛的事情，所以個人的自由行動不應被國家所阻礙。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
If I were King, all the restrictions would be removed and liberal life would be allowed to everyone in an invulnerable range.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
如果我是國王，我會廢除所有限制，讓每個人都能在安全的範圍內享受自由的生活。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Coming to think of my family, my people are so conservative and not flexible.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
說到我的家人，他們太保守了，一點也不靈活。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
They keep saying to not do this and that, that is dangerous and this is natural... The nagging has been endless all throughout my life...
scripts.translation:
[坡]
他們總是說這個不行那個不行，那個危險這個自然...這種嘮叨從我出生起就沒停過...

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Ah, those last words
are off-the-record.
I don't want to be bothered by my family.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
啊，最後幾句話是私下說的。
我不想被家人找麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Experiencing anything new!
I don't care what it is!
scripts.translation:
[坡]
體驗任何新事物！
我不在乎那是什麼！

scripts.text:
[Poe]
If our time is the exploring age, I possibly am the captain of an exploring group! Unexplored, pathfinding, investigating... Those are my middle names. How about you??
scripts.translation:
[坡]
如果我們的時代是探索時代，那我可能就是探索隊的船長！未探索、開路、調查...這些就是我的別名。你呢？

scripts.text:
[Poe]
But many say, about my character, that I am addicted to gambling. I am just full of a challenging spirit and I like raking in money! I am a free-spirited normal man.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
但很多人說，關於我的性格，我沉迷於賭博。我只是充滿挑戰精神，喜歡贏錢！我是個自由奔放的普通人。

scripts.text:
[Poe]
Alright,
let's meet next at some more exciting and dangerous spot.
scripts.translation:
[坡]
好了，下次我們在更刺激、更危險的地方見面吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Appraiser.
Have you met the little girl in Aldebaran?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
評估員。
你見過艾爾帕蘭那個小女孩嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I saw her for you.
scripts.translation: 是的，我替您見過她了

scripts.text: No, I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 不，我不想見

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I am glad that the girl liked it. Once I got cured, I wanted to go meet with her.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
很高興她喜歡。等我痊癒後，我想去見她一面。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Anyhow, thanks for your good work. I really feel sorry about bothering you with trifle things. This is my sense of gratitude. Don't feel so much burden and take this.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
總之，謝謝你的幫忙。真抱歉讓你為我這些瑣事操心。這是我的心意，別覺得有負擔，收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Thinking about the little girl calms me. I still can't believe my eyes. My prince Ahrum who just passed away...~
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
想到那個小女孩，我就感到平靜。我到現在還不敢相信自己的眼睛。我的王子阿魯姆剛剛才去世...~

scripts.text:
[Peter]
As you said.
I've heard that her life is like a flower when I lost it.
I will go see her on my own.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
正如你所說。
聽說她的生命就像一朵花，在我失去它的時候綻放。
我會親自去見她的。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I really feel sorry about bothering you with trifle things. Please take this.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
真抱歉讓你為我這些瑣事操心。請收下這個。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Never mind.
I still can't believe my eyes. My prince Ahrum who just passed away...~~
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
算了。
我到現在還不敢相信自己的眼睛。我的王子阿魯姆剛剛才去世...~~

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Child... What the heck happened to you?...
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
孩子...你到底怎麼了？...

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I really appreciate it.
You are so kind.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
非常感謝。
你真好。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I am glad that the girl liked it. Once I got cured, I wanted to go meet with her.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
很高興她喜歡。等我痊癒後，我想去見她一面。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Anyhow, thanks for your good work. I really feel sorry about bothering you with trifle things. This is my sense of gratitude. Don't feel so much burden and take this.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
總之，謝謝你的幫忙。真抱歉讓你為我這些瑣事操心。這是我的心意，別覺得有負擔，收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Do you have any more
business, appraiser?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
評估員，你還有其他事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prince]
I think you are not allowed
to be here.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
我想你不該來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Prince]
Hello,
I am Peter, from the family of Heine. I am glad to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[王子]
你好，我是海爾內家族的彼得。很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Now, where shall we start?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
那麼，我們從哪裡開始呢？

scripts.text: Your background story...
scripts.translation: 你的身世背景...

scripts.text: Your view of the nation...
scripts.translation: 你對國家的看法...

scripts.text: Hobbies and interests...
scripts.translation: 興趣愛好...

scripts.text: I will come by later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Peter]
My family was not that influential. My childhood was not that abundant; I had to seek jobs and make money from part-time jobs.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我的家族並沒有那麼顯赫。我的童年也不算富裕，我不得不四處找工作，靠兼職賺錢。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
But it helped me to check people's lives; the full particulars. That's my good side.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
但這讓我有機會觀察人們的生活，瞭解其中的細節。這是我的優點。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Was it enough for your question?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
這足以回答你的問題了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I guess the important thing is if people fulfill themselves in their field, then only supplements of support is needed from the nation's side.
What I want to say, in short, is the nation does not reign. People need to keep peace with people.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我想，重要的是人們在自己的領域裡實現自我，國家只需要提供必要的支援。
簡而言之，國家並不統治一切。人們需要彼此和睦相處。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Accordingly, I will take benefits away from the difference of classes. It is not an equality issue, but for the ascension of national power.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
因此，我會取消因階級差異而產生的特權。這並非出於平等的考量，而是為了提升國力。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I only like reading books as a hobby. I think men should go forward; they need to have a striving attitude.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我唯一的愛好就是讀書。我認為男人應該向前看，需要有一種進取的態度。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Ah, is that it?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
啊，是這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Then I have a favor to ask of you... Can you listen to my story?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
那麼，我有一個請求...你能聽聽我的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Originally, I didn't like growing a beard... but I had one opportunity to change... My thoughts recently are that someone has offered me the chance.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
原本，我並不喜歡留鬍子...但有一次機會改變了我的看法...最近我覺得，是有人給了我這個機會。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
It is because of an unknown girl's letter...
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
是因為一位陌生女孩的信...

scripts.text:
[Peter]
What she told me in the letter was that my image was too sharp, and if I grew my beard, the contour of my face would be quite hidden; and it would look far better.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
她在信裡告訴我，我的形象太尖銳了，如果留了鬍子，臉部的輪廓就會柔和很多，看起來會好看得多。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I want to repay her.
Because her words helped me much. Nothing special, but maybe a small bunch of flowers.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我想報答她。
因為她的話幫了我很多。沒什麼特別的，也許就是一小束花吧。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Would you take these flowers and give thanks to that girl somewhere in Al de Baran?
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
你能把這些花帶到艾爾帕蘭，替我感謝那位女孩嗎？

scripts.text: Okay, no problem.
scripts.translation: 沒問題，交給我吧

scripts.text: Please ask it of another.
scripts.translation: 請找別人吧

scripts.text:
[Peter]
Yeah, thank you very much.
Please take care.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
好的，非常感謝。
請多保重。

scripts.text:
[Peter]
I understand you...
I know you have your
own business.
scripts.translation:
[彼得]
我理解你...
我知道你有自己的事情要忙。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Wooah, Uncle Peter sent these flowers
for me?
Hmmm~ They smell really good.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
哇，彼得叔叔送的花是給我的嗎？
嗯~ 聞起來真香。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hehe~ You must be a friend of Peter's.
When you have a chance to meet him
later, please give my regards to uncle Peter.
Tell him that I loved the flowers so so much...
Okay, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
呵呵~ 你一定是彼得的朋友吧。
下次見到他時，請幫我向彼得叔叔問好。
告訴他我很喜歡這些花...非常非常喜歡...
好了，下次見。

scripts.text:
[Girl]
I will go home early and
Put these flowers in a vase.
Lalala~
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
我要早點回家，把這些花插進花瓶裡。
啦啦啦~

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey you, have you heard the story of Daddy-Long-Legs? ... ...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿，你聽過長腿叔叔的故事嗎？... ...

scripts.text:
[Girl]
Hey you, have you heard the story of Daddy-Long-Legs? ... ...
scripts.translation:
[女孩]
嘿，你聽過長腿叔叔的故事嗎？... ...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
How is Ernst ...?
He is so serious about everything. He doesn't make trouble or have outbursts... He can be kind of weird.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
恩斯特怎麼樣...？
他對一切都那麼認真。他不惹麻煩，也不發脾氣...他有點奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
We were close friends. Unlike me, he is kind and compassionate; a distinct official of public affairs. When he has to be strict, he turns strict with everyone.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我們是親密的朋友。不像我，他善良且富有同情心；是一位出色的公職人員。當他需要嚴格時，他對所有人都很嚴格。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I am Eigen Ahrum,
I will be the light of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我是艾根·阿魯姆，我將成為盧恩·米德加茲的光。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Whoever be the king, let's make Rune-Midgarts... the best country in the world, by helping each other.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
無論誰成為國王，讓我們互相幫助，把盧恩·米德加茲...建設成世界上最好的國家。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
We can make it.
No, we shall make it. For Brother and I together, we shall make it.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我們能做到的。
不，我們一定能做到。我和哥哥一起，一定能做到。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
But... If I am to reign, or help you; and if I am corrupted... you kill me... by your hand.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
但是...如果我掌權，或者輔佐你；如果我變得腐敗...你就殺了我...用你的雙手。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
In the opposite case, I will kill you too, you understand? So don't ever stray, and do not ever forget your determination.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
反之亦然，我也會殺了你，你明白嗎？
所以永遠不要偏離正道，也永遠不要忘記你的決心。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, you think about hell. It will never happen, so... Don't talk that way.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，你想得也太可怕了。
那種事永遠不會發生的，所以...別那樣說。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It is an assumption.
Don't take it too seriously.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
那只是一個假設。
別太當真。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Alright, alright. Don't
take it the wrong way.
I have been acting for Brother and Kingdom, and I will be the same ever after.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
好的，好的。別誤會。
我一直為了哥哥和王國在行動，以後也會一樣。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ah, the appraiser has come.
How could you appear so suddenly? Ern and I were in the middle of conversation.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
啊，評估員來了。
你怎麼突然出現？我和恩斯特正在談話。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What's wrong, brother? We were not talking about anything bad. We were just making our resolution firm.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
怎麼了，哥哥？我們沒在說壞事。
我們只是在堅定我們的決心。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You came here in good timing. We've just decided to kill the other... if one of us is corrupt.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你來得正是時候。我們剛決定，如果其中一人腐敗，就殺掉對方。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
By all means, be the witness of this agreement. You cannot say no. Because it is a very good thing, in some respects, for your work, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
無論如何，請見證這個約定。
你不能拒絕。因為從某些方面來說，這對你的工作很有利，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Br...Brother. You are way too suppressive. Our appraiser must have his own position and opinion.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥。你太霸道了。
我們的評估員必須有自己的立場和意見。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You still have a weak personality. I am not forcing something so difficult on him! Who cares? I take silence as a positive answer! My bid is successful! And our promise is formed too!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你的個性還是太弱了。我並沒有強迫他做這麼難的事！
誰在乎呢？我把沉默當作肯定的回答！我的提議成功了！
我們的約定也成立了！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Haah...haha... Appraiser, I deeply apologize for offending you. Sorry, but there is no possibility of fulfilling this promise. So, just don't take this situation seriously... You know... When pigs fly... ~
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哈...哈哈...評估員，非常抱歉冒犯了你。
抱歉，但這承諾是不可能實現的。所以，別太當真...你知道的...
除非豬會飛...~

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Now, let me return to my room. Keep up the good work, appraiser.
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
現在，讓我回房間了。繼續努力吧，評估員。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I heard that one person
from my family is coming today. But I haven't found him yet.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我聽說今天有一個人來自我的家族。但我還沒找到他。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
I worry about your words...
What do you want to say this time?...
Have you seen him, appraiser?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
我憂心你的話...
這次你想說什麼？...
你見到他了嗎，評估員？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Aahh...boring, boring.
I am in real penance right now!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
啊...無聊，無聊。
我現在簡直是在受罪！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You come here so often.

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Is that so? Then, see you later.

scripts.text:

Suffering? Me?..Aaahhh... It looks so...? Yeahh... Yes, it does. Stressful...Huhuhu...Hahaha!!
scripts.translation:

痛苦？我嗎？...啊...看起來確實很...？是啊...是的，確實如此。壓力好大...呼呼...哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Brother, Ahrum...?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥哥，阿魯姆...？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

...只有我能擺脫這一切嗎...總之，我是個不合格的人...呼呼。不過，我已經做出了決定。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ernst.
scripts.translation:

恩斯特。

scripts.text:

Yes?... Yes?
scripts.translation:

是？...是？

scripts.text:

Take this.
scripts.translation:

拿著這個。

scripts.translation: - 阿魯姆隨手將一把華麗短劍扔給了恩斯特。-

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Eh?... What's this about?... A Bazerald of Walter family?...Why?
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
呃？...這是怎麼回事？...沃爾特家族的華麗短劍？...為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Now this is perfect timing. Even our witness is here! Ern, you remember our promise clearly, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
時機真是完美。連我們的證人都在場！恩斯特，你很清楚我們之間的約定，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
What? Promise? Witness?...Ahh... Re-really...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
什麼？約定？證人？...啊...真...真的是...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Yes, really. Now is the time.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
沒錯，就是現在。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Nonsense! Do you think I can do that to you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
胡說！你以為我會對你下殺手嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Idiot! Being King should be followed by decisive action. I have no chances to be King. Corruption, and living like that, is worse than being killed by you...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
蠢貨！身為國王，就該有決斷力。我根本沒有機會成為國王。腐敗，像這樣苟活，比被你殺死更糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B-but, you can live as you are! As if nothing happened. You are just needed to return to the way you were before. Brother, let me help you. Tell me everything you hide...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...不，你可以像以前一樣活下去！就當什麼都沒發生過。你只需要回到從前的樣子。哥哥，讓我幫幫你。告訴我你隱藏的一切...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
This is so moronic! Can you say that you are kingly?! Are you showing me sympathy now? You should be a man of sense! If not, you are not eligible as a king candidate!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
這太愚蠢了！你還能說自己有王者風範嗎？現在才來同情我？你應該是個有理智的人！如果不是，你就沒有資格成為國王候選人！

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bu...but!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
不...但是！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Talking back and forth is of no use! I cannot help it. If you keep insisting instead of trying to be a man of sense, then such a person should not be a king.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
這樣來回爭論毫無意義！我別無選擇。如果你堅持己見，而不是像個有理智的人那樣行事，那麼這樣的人就不配當國王。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ghh?! Brother?!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
嘎？！哥哥？！

scripts.text: (dagger thrusting sound)
scripts.translation: (短劍刺入的聲音)

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Bbb... Brother?... You... told me 
you would kill me... You just wanted to be killed
by me?... Bbb...brother?...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥？...你...你說過要殺我...你只是想讓我殺你嗎？...哥...哥哥？...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu... Not at all. I just wanted to kill you... That's it... Good job, Ern... This is legal self-defense, killing a villain... right?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
呵呵...完全不是。我只是想殺了你...就這樣...幹得好，恩斯特...這是合法的正當防衛，殺死一個惡棍...對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother... even now it is not too late! If you go to a medic, you can be restored!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...現在還不晚！如果你去找醫務兵，還能救回來！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
It's too late... Once your vital organs are stabbed... I wonder how could I stay alive... or even how I could come back to life... I don't need to live.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
太晚了...一旦要害被刺穿...我還能怎麼活下來...或者怎麼復活...我不需要活著。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
B..Brother....How...how could you?!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
哥...哥哥...你...你怎麼能這樣？！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Goodbye, my brother... Be King, and change this nation. You... You can make it...guk...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
再見了，我的哥哥...成為國王，改變這個國家。你...你可以做到的...咕...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
...Brother...Brother... Why... Why... How can your face look so satisfied? How...? Brother...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
...哥哥...哥哥...為什麼...為什麼...你的表情看起來那麼滿足？怎麼...？哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Huhu...You don't need to know that. By the way, you kept your promise... You should be king... But if you are lost, and stray, I will come kill you at any time... from hell!!
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
呵呵...你不需要知道。順便說一句，你守住了承諾...你應該成為國王...但如果你迷失了方向，偏離了正道，我會隨時從地獄爬出來殺了你...

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
I...I don't know! I don't know what's going on!
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
我...我不知道！我不知道發生了什麼！

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
You don't need to... What you have to know about is that there was a sacrifice from me. To make my death meaningful, you should be a good king. That's my conviction... That's it..guk..! Don't lose my words... gukkuk.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
你不必...你要知道的是，我做出了犧牲。為了讓我的死有意義，你應當成為一位好國王。這是我的信念...就是這樣...咕...！別把我的話忘了...咕咕。

scripts.text:
[Ernst]
Idiot... Moron...
scripts.translation:
[恩斯特]
笨蛋...蠢貨...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ahh... Appraiser, do you know what you have to do? Be mindful of your words. About what you saw, what you heard... You must not tell all of your experience to the inspector.
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
啊...評估員，你知道該怎麼做嗎？謹言慎行。關於你看到的、聽到的...你絕不能把你的經歷全部告訴檢查員。

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
Ern killed a villain here who bullied around.. I had no chance... He showed decisive action, and that will deserve him the right to be king...
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
恩斯特在這裡殺死了那個橫行霸道的惡棍...我沒有機會...他展現了果斷的行動，這足以讓他擁有成為國王的資格...

scripts.text:
[Ahrum]
If you react wrongfully to this incident, my death will be worthless...kuk... Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[阿魯姆]
如果你對此事反應不當，我的死將毫無價值...咕...你明白嗎？

scripts.text: ... Okay I will follow your will...
scripts.translation: 好的，我會遵從你的意願...
